title: Le Cocó wins España Season 4
summary: In the live Final Battle (ES-S04-E12), La Bella Vampi and Le Cocó lip-synced to Nina's "Va todo al ganador". Le Cocó was crowned the winner.

title: Reina de la Suerte twist
summary: Season 4 introduced Reina de la Suerte: the queen holding the Lucky Queen figurine could swap out of an elimination lip sync. La Bella Vampi used it in ES-S04-E07.

title: Shani LaSanta: Season 4 Porkchop
summary: Shani LaSanta was the first contestant eliminated on España Season 4 (ES-S04-E01), lip-syncing to "Las 12" against La Niña Delantro.
